gaps.title: Transcript / code review-ergonomics
gaps.notes: HL.HF-3a Review-Before-Signing Rate and HL.HF-3b Time-to-Sign Distribution (sub-parts of HL.HF-3 Inadequate-Review Detection post-v3.7) already capture whether review happens and how long it takes. "Ergonomics" as a distinct construct is hard to operationalise without subjective instruments; not a pure measurement gap. Revisit only if HL.HF-3 sub-parts prove insufficient in practice.

gaps.title: Transcript relevance / signal-preservation
gaps.notes: Most AVT products don't expose the raw transcript to the clinician; measurement would apply to a minority of deployments. Signal-preservation is also already bracketed by TP.SN-6 Omission Rate (summary level) and TP.SN-11 MEDIC Cross-Examination. Narrow additional value.

gaps.title: Transcript edit metrics (parallel to summary)
gaps.notes: Only meaningful where the transcript is user-editable - a minority feature. HL.HF-* metrics can be applied to transcript edits by analogy if the product supports it; no new metric needed.

gaps.title: Configurability surface integrity
gaps.notes: Meta-property of product configuration surfaces (whether safety-critical features can be toggled off). Unusual measurement shape - closer to a design review than a continuous metric. Out of scope for an assurance metrics taxonomy; belongs to vendor-transparency reporting. Revisit only if configuration-related incidents surface.

gaps.title: Subgroup Drift Monitoring Plan
gaps.notes: Documented plan for monitoring performance drift across demographic subgroups post-deployment.

gaps.title: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis Availability
gaps.notes: For Tier C AVT: CEA with QALY or cost-consequences. Research-grade for most deployments.

gaps.title: Budget Impact Analysis Completeness
gaps.notes: Direct and indirect costs; NHS reference costs; sensitivity analysis. Extends GV.OP-7.

gaps.title: Per-Resource UK Core Conformance
gaps.notes: Stratified conformance by resource type (Composition, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, etc.).

gaps.title: UK Core Extension Conformance
gaps.notes: NHS Number verification status, Ethnic Category, Birth Sex, Death Notification extensions.

gaps.title: STU Version Targeting Declaration
gaps.notes: Vendor declaration of which UK Core STU version(s) supported. Procurement requirement.

gaps.title: CSO AI Oversight Capacity
gaps.notes: Protected time / budget for CSO to oversee AI safety (not just sign-off). Operational capacity.

gaps.title: AI-Specific Complaint Handling Rate
gaps.notes: Rate of complaints about AI-generated records and their resolution time. Also flagged under RAI Theme 5 (Contestability).

gaps.title: Record Quality Composite (Reg 17)
gaps.notes: Composite of content accuracy, completeness, and timeliness against Reg 17 good-governance standard.

gaps.title: Systems-Based Incident Analysis Rate
gaps.notes: Proportion of AI-related safety incidents receiving SEIPS-informed systems analysis. Also flagged under RAI Theme 1 (Safety).

gaps.title: Compassionate Engagement with Affected Patients
gaps.notes: Rate at which patients/families affected by AI-related harm received early contact, named liaison, and draft report review.

gaps.title: Staff Just Culture Protection
gaps.notes: Staff survey on whether they feel supported vs blamed after AI-related incidents. Organisational culture.

gaps.title: Learning Implementation Tracking
gaps.notes: Did identified learning actually change practice? Closure rate on systemic actions.

gaps.title: Professional Narrative Preservation
gaps.notes: Ratio of free-text narrative vs structured extraction; flags over-structurisation and loss of clinical nuance.

gaps.title: Communication Needs (AIS) Capture
gaps.notes: Whether Accessible Information Standard flags (interpreter, BSL, etc.) are captured and preserved. Accessibility-critical.

gaps.title: Legal Status Information Capture
gaps.notes: Whether MHA status, DoLS, LPA, advance decisions are preserved when present. Clinical-legal critical.

gaps.title: Per-Data-Item Necessity Documentation
gaps.notes: DPIA-level documentation of why each data element processed is necessary. Granular and burdensome but thorough.

gaps.title: AI Translation Accuracy & Liability Attribution
gaps.notes: Accuracy of AI-generated language translation in AVT output, with explicit documentation that liability for translation errors rests with the vendor, not the clinician. T.E.S.T. names translation as a distinctive clinical safety surface; no existing metric.

gaps.title: Training Data Anonymisation Provenance
gaps.notes: Documented provenance of anonymisation technique applied to AI training data (ICO-aligned). Extends GV.PD-7 Training Data Inclusion Status, which covers inclusion declaration but not anonymisation quality.

gaps.title: Total Cost of Ownership / Formal Economic Evaluation
gaps.notes: Formal multi-dimensional economic evaluation including ROI, operational savings, and full TCO. Extends GV.OP-7 (per-consultation cost) and GV.OP-8 (governance burden) with a top-down economic view that T.E.S.T. weights at 25 of 420 points. Distinct from NICE-derived Cost-Effectiveness and Budget Impact candidates (§2b) — this is an NHS-procurement-framed TCO view.

gaps.title: Multi-Specialty Validation Coverage
gaps.notes: Count and breadth of clinical specialties in which the AVT has been formally validated (medical, surgical, allied health). T.E.S.T. awards 10 pts for multi-specialty validation; no existing metric captures breadth of validation scope.

gaps.title: Virtual-Care Modality Stratified Performance
gaps.notes: Performance stratified by consultation modality (in-person, video, telephone, ambulance triage). Existing IO.FE-1 covers deployment equity by site/setting but not by modality. T.E.S.T. singles out ambulance telephone triage as a distinct high-weight case (10 pts).

gaps.title: Sovereign AI / UK Supply Chain Disclosure
gaps.notes: Disclosure of whether the vendor and underlying model stack are UK-based (contributing to UK PLC per T.E.S.T. domain 12). Procurement transparency surface. Complements GV.VT-7 Sub-Processor Transparency with sovereignty-specific attribute.
